eligibility: Parseable Python modules with 20--600 nonblank lines and a locally used, nonprivate function parameter; tests, examples, benchmarks, package initializers, and vendored trees excluded.
evidence_boundary: The audit measures transformation materialization and parse-and-compile success. It does not establish behavioral equivalence or repository-population prevalence.
purpose: Frozen multi-project parser-transfer audit for controlled source interventions.
selection: Within each project, order eligible modules by nonblank line count and hashed-path tie break; choose nearest ranks to the 5th, 27.5th, 50th, 72.5th, and 95th percentiles before observing intervention outcomes.
